Drishyam The Conclusion Box Office Day 3 (Worldwide): Ajay Devgn, Jaideep Ahlawat’s Crime Thriller Grosses Over Rs 250 Cr During Opening Weekend

Grinell Jacinto
  • October 5, 2026
  • 12:21 pm
  • Comments off

Ajay Devgn-led Drishyam 3 The Conclusion continues to impress the masses not just in India but overseas too. Check out the film's worldwide box office performance over its opening weekend here:

The final chapter in the Hindi version of Drishyam – titled Drishyam The Conclusion, released on Friday, October 2 and is being by the public. With an average of over 50% occupancy per day in India, the Ajay Devgn, Jaideep Ahlawat and Tabu-led crime thriller has collected over Rs 170 crore net in India and a surplus of Rs 250 crore at the global box office. Scroll below to know the exact numbers.

Drishyam The Conclusion Box Office

As reported by trade website Sacnilk, Drishyam 3 earned a tad bit more on Sunday compared to its Saturday collection. According to their report, the Ajay Devgn-led film collected Rs 61.00 crore net across 17,323 shows on Day 2. Combined with its Day 1 and Day 2 collection, the film’s India net collection amounts to Rs 176.50 crore.

As per the same report, the film saw an overall occupancy of 64.29% on Day 3, with the hightest being in the evening (80.46%) followed by afternoon (72.08%), night (62.23%) and morning (42.38%). Its Sunday footfalls were over 24 lakh (24,12,130 to be exact).

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by Star Studio18 (@starstudio18)

Talking about its global performance, Drishyam The Conclusion has collected Rs 20 crore overseas. When combined with the film’s domestic gross collection of Rs 211.80 crore, the film’s worldwide gross box office total reached an impressive Rs 272.80 crore. With this total, the film is currently among the Top 5 highest grossing Bollywood films of 2026.

About The Film

Directed by Abhishek Pathak, Drishyam The Conclusion stars Ajay Devgn, Tabu, Shriya Saran, Rajat Kapoor, Jaideep Ahlawat and Prakash Raj, Kamlesh Sawant, Ishita Dutta and Mrunal Jadhav among others bringing together a powerhouse ensemble for the ultimate chapter of the celebrated franchise.

Presented by Star Studio18, the Panorama Studios production is directed by Abhishek Pathak and written by Abhishek Pathak, Aamil Keeyan Khan and Parveez Shaikh. Produced by Alok Jain, Ajit Andhare, Kumar Mangat Pathak and Abhishek Pathak, Drishyam The Conclusion is all set to release theatrically on 2nd October 2026.
